fusions.name: Trace Whip
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted chain at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stampede Sweep
fusions.desc: Drags a mass of chain through a cone ahead of you that deals 34 damage to everything within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Drumming Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Momentum
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
